description: Election Commission - S. Thayananthan was elected as the member of the Porathve Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Porathivu Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is an electoral process matter. It involves the declaration of a newly elected member under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it clearly related to electoral processes and declarations, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
